autoplay.label: Autoplay

off.title: Off
off.text: Playback stops when the queue ends.

lib.title: From your library
lib.text: When the queue is about to end, similar songs from your library are added, in the same language as what's playing.

free.title: Anything
free.text: Same, plus a few new songs by that artist or similar ones, downloaded in the background.

autoplay.hint: The radio button at the top of the queue switches Autoplay: Off → From your library → Anything (adds new songs, downloaded in the background).

queue.empty: The queue is empty. Pick a song to start.

lyrics.none: No lyrics for this song yet
lyrics.offset: Lyrics ahead of or behind the music?
lyrics.offsetHint: Only for you, saved per song.
lyrics.freeSearch: Or type freely (title + artist, a line from the lyrics…)
lyrics.noResults: No lyrics found. Try fewer words, or search with a line from the song.
lyrics.picked: Lyrics picked. When several listeners pick the same, others get them suggested too.
lyrics.pasteHint: Paste plain lyrics, or LRC ([mm:ss.xx] line) for synced lyrics. Only you see them.
lyrics.offline: Offline · these lyrics aren't stored on this device

sleep.title: Sleep timer
sleep.endOfTrackOn: Stops at the end of this song
